tei:titleStmt.tei:title: bla brgyud kha skong sman mchod nā len+d+ra ltar du yin/༄༅/ /rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod kyi sgrub thabs thun mong ma yin pa'i
bla brgyud kha skong sman mchod nā len+d+ra ltar du yin/༄༅/ /rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod kyi sgrub thabs thun mong ma yin pa'i

tei:div.tei:p: bla brgyud kha skong sman mchod nā len+d+ra ltar du yin/༄༅// rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod kyi sgrub thabs thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyun khyer ngag 'don bklags chog tu bkod pa bzhugs so//

༄༅// nā ro mkha' spyod kyi brgyud pa'i rim pa la gsol ba 'debs pa pad dkar bzhad pa'i dga' ston zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༈ /na mo gu ru badz+ra wā ra hī/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i rigs bdag rdo rje chos// rgyal ba'i yum mchog rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// rgyal sras thu bo nā ro ta pa'i zhabs// gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes stsol// gsang chen slob bshad 'dzin pa'i pham thing pa// gsang mdzod kun gyi gter gyur shes rab brtsegs// gsang sngags rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag mal lo'i zhabs// gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes stsol// rdo rje 'chang chen bla chen sa skya pa// rdo rje'i sras mchog rje btsun bsod nams rtse// rdo rje 'dzin pa'i gtsug rgyan grags pa'i zhabs// gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes stsol// sa skya paṇa chen gangs can mkhas pa'i rje// sa gsum skye rgu'i gtsug rgyan 'phags pa'i mchog /sa skya'i bstan 'dzin zhang ston dkon mchog dpal// gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes stsol// grub pa'i dbang po na bza' brag phug pa// grub mchog mkhas pa'i ded dpon chos kyi rje// sgrub rigs snyan brgyud mnga' bdag yar klung par// gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes stsol// bdag gzhan 'gro ba'i skyabs mgon rgyal ba mchog /bdag nyid chen po 'jam dbyangs nam mkha'i mtshan// bdag chen chos rje blo gros rgyal mtshan zhabs// gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes stsol// bka' drin mnyam med rje btsun rdo rings pa// bka' bzhin sgrub pa'i bstan 'dzin blo gsal dbang*// bka' brgyud gsang chen smra ba mkhyen brtse'i zhabs// gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes stsol// rig sngags 'chang ba bslab gsum rgyal mtshan dang*// rigs brgya'i khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan dpal// rigs kyi gtso bo rje btsun bka' 'gyur ba// gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes stsol// dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i khyab bdag zha lu ba// dkyil 'khor kun gyi gtso bo mkhyen rab rje// dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i bdag po rnam gnyis la// gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes stsol// snyan brgyud rgya mtsho'i ded dpon rdo rje 'dzin// snyan brgyud mnga' bdag rmor chen rdo rje 'chang*// snyan brgyud spel mkhas legs pa'i 'byung gnas la// gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes stsol// rigs brgya'i khyab bdag kun dga' blo gros dang*// rig 'dzin chen po bstan 'dzin lhun grub zhabs// rig gnas mthar son blo gsal phun tshogs la// gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes stsol// rnam mkhyen bla ma bzhi yi thugs kyi sras// rnam mang 'gro la brtse ba'i lhag bsam can// rnam 'dren 'khor lo'i mgon po mkhyen rab rje// gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes stsol// zab gsang snyan brgyud gdams pa ma lus pa'i// zab don mdzod 'dzin gzim 'og rdo rje 'chang*// zab lam mnga' bdag rig 'dzin maṅga'i mtshan// gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes stsol// dngos po kun gyi rang bzhin de bzhin nyid// dngos su gzigs pa'i dpal ldan gu ṇa pa// dngos grub mchog stsol rje btsun ya sha'i mtshan// gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes stsol// rnam mang ma gyur 'gro ba'i mgon gcig pu// rnam 'dren grub pa'i dbang phyug pradz+nyā'i mtshan// rnam gsum 'dus zhal rje btsun nā ga'i zhabs// gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes stsol// bstan pa'i mnga' bdag 'khon rigs sa skya pa'i// bstan 'dzin dam pa lce btsun mkhyen brtse'i dbang*// bstan pa'i gsal byed kun dga'i mtshan can la// gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes stsol// gsang chen rgyud sde'i mthar thug gsang mtha'i bcud// gsang sngags zab mo'i nye lam gdams pa'i mchog

/gsang mdzod ston mkhas rtsa ba'i bla ma la// gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes stsol/ ༈ /dal 'byor gru chen mi rtag dran pa yi// ba dan dkar pos bskyod pa'i las 'bras kyi// blang dor mthun pa'i rlung gis rab bskul nas// 'jigs rung 'khor ba'i mtsho las sgrol bar shog /bslu med skyabs gnas gtsug gi nor bur bsten// mar gyur 'gro ba'i don chen snying la zhugs// rdor sems bdud rtsis nyes pa'i dri ma bkrus// rje btsun bla ma'i thugs rjes skyong bar shog /yid 'ong rgyal yum phyi yi rnal 'byor ma// bam̐ yig nang gi rdo rje btsun mo mchog /sems nyid stong gsal gsang ba'i mkha' spyod yum// rang zhal mthong ba'i rtse dgas rol bar shog /snod kyi 'jig rten e yig gzhal med khang*// bcud kyi sems can bam̐ yig rnal 'byor ma// zung 'jug bde ba chen po'i ting 'dzin gyis// cir snang dag pa'i snang bar 'char bar shog /de ltar phyogs dang zla ba'i rnal 'byor gyis// nam zhig dus na dga' ma byi ru'i mdog /li khri'i skra grol dmar ser mig g.yo mas// mngon sum rig 'dzin grong du 'khrid par shog /sin+dhur laṅka li ya'i sdong bur bcas// ro ldan gnas su bsgrubs shing yul kun tu// nyul bas gang gi mdzod spur 'khyil ris can// 'phos pa'i mdzes mas mkha' spyod 'khrid par shog /nang gi phag mos gzung 'dzin 'khri shing bcom// mchog gi dhū tir zhugs pa'i gar mkhan ma// tshangs pa'i sgo nas sprin lam dbyings su thon// khrag 'thung dpa' bor 'khyud cing rol bar shog /lte ba'i pad+mor rlung lnga'i ti la ka /rtse gcig bsgom pa'i kha sbyor rnal 'byor gyis// lus sems rtsa la dri bzhon zhugs pa yi// bde ba mchog gis bdag rgyud tshim par shog /tha mal 'od kyi gtum mo mdzes ldan ma// dhū tir 'dzum dkar bzhad pa'i rol rtsed kyis// haṃ yig gzhon nu yongs su mnyes byas nas// zung 'jug bde ba chen po'i sa thob shog

/skye 'gag gnas gsum bral ba gdod ma'i gshis// stong gsal brjod du med pa gnyug ma'i ngang*// zung 'jug blo 'das rang sems rnal 'byor ma// rang ngo shes nas rtag tu skyong bar shog /rtsa rlung thig le e wam̐ dbyings su thim// sems nyid bde chen chos sku'i dpal thob nas// bgrang yas gzugs sku'i rnam rol dpag med kyis// nam mkha'i mtha' klas 'gro 'di skyong bar shog /ces 'phags yul gyi paṇa grub kun gyi gtsug gi nor bu jo bo nā ro ta pa mngon sum du rjes su bzung ba'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod du grags pa'i bla ma brgyud pa la gsol ba 'debs pa lam gyi rim pa'i smon lam dang bcas pa mchog gi pad+mo bzhad pa'i dga' ston zhes bya ba 'di ni/ rdo rje btsun mo'i zhabs kyis ring nas bskyangs pa'i rnal 'byor pa blo gsal gyis stod lung sba ra'i gzim khang gi me mtshams kyi ba gam bzhi pa rak+ta bzhad pa'i phyogs kyi tshes la sbyar ba dge legs 'phel// ༈ //bla ma dang rje btsun mkha' spyod ma dbyer med pa'i zhabs la dus dang gnas skabs thams cad du phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// brtse ba chen pos rjes su gzung zhing byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol/ 'dir rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i sgrub thabs thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyun khyer ngag 'don bklags chog ma'i tshul ni/ skyabs yul rnams gsal btab la/ bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes ci mang brjod/ thal mo snying gar sbyar la/ bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// khyed rnams kyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/

zhes brjod/ sems bskyed pa ni/ bdag gis rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par byas la/ sems can thams cad srid pa'i sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen po las bsgral bar bya/ de'i phyir du rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i lam gyi rim pa zab mo nyams su blang bar bgyi'o// zhes lan gsum brjod/ rdor sems bsgom bzlas ni/ rang gi spyi bor pad+ma pad+ma dkar po'i sdong bu tshangs bug la zug pa/ mchan/ dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' dpal he ru ka sku mdog dkar po/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ rang 'dra'i rigs bdag gi dbu rgyan can/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje snyems ma sku mdog dkar mo/ gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ yab kyi thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ dkar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi snying po ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rnam par spyan drangs nas hūm̐ la thim/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad kyis tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ hūm̐ las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ he ru ka'i sku gang*/ de nas dbyibs brgyud/ yum gyi sku gang*/ yab yum gnyis kyi sbyor mtshams nas bdud rtsi babs/ bdag gi spyi gtsug nas zhugs pas/ nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad dud khu'am/ rnag khrag srog chags mi sdug pa'i rnam pas bshang gci gnyis dang*/ rkang mthil gnyis nas thon/ shul thams cad bdud rtsis gang bar gyur/ ces brjod cing bsams la/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he ru ka sa ma ya ma nu pā la ya/

he ru ka te no pa tiṣ+ṭha/ dṛ ḍho me bha wa/ su to ṣ+yo me bha wa/ a nu rak+to me bha wa/ su po ṣ+yo me bha wa/ sarba sid+dhim+me pra yats+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa me/ tsit+taṃ shri yaḥku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥbha ga wān badz+ra he ru ka mā me muñca he ru ko bha wa/ ma hā sa ma ya sa twa āḥhūm̐ phaṭa/ ces nyer gcig sogs ci nus kyi mthar thal mo sbyar te/ mgon po bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa ste// dam tshig las ni 'gal zhing nyams// bla ma mgon pos skyabs mdzod cig /gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ste// thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can// 'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs mchi// sku gsung thugs rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams pa thams cad mthol lo bshags so// sdig pa dang sgrib pa/ nyes pa dang ltung ba/ dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum 'od du zhu/ rang gi spyi bo nas thim pas lus shel sgong g.ya' dag pa lta bur gyur par bsam/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor rgyas pa ni/ mdun gyi nam mkhar dag gsal gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi snang ba las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs dang bcas pa/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su seng ge chen po brgyad kyis btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba nyi ma'i gdan gyi steng du drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma de nyid sangs rgyas rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa can/ sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu thugs kar bsnol nas 'dzin pa/ dbu skra ral pa'i cod pan can/ zhabs rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ gzhon nu lang tsho bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod can/ dar dang rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ de'i mtha' skor du mdun nas brtsams te/ pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan re re'i steng du/ sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang*/

rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ grub chen nā ro ta pa/ pham thing pa sku mched/ klog skya shes rab brtsegs/ mal lo tsā ba blo gros grags pa/ rje btsun sa skya pa chen po/ slob dpon bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/ chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pa/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ na bza' brag phug pa/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa/ yar lung pa seng ge rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen bsod nams rgyal mchog 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ bdag chen rdo rje 'chang*/ rje btsun rdo rings pa chen po/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug mkhan chen bslab gsum rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ rin chen bsod nams mchog grub/ mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ rmor chen ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ ngag dbang kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros/ byams pa nam mkha' 'chi med/ byams pa nam mkha' legs pa lhun grub/ rje btsun ma 'chi med bstan pa'i nyi ma/ 'dren mchog ngag dbang rin chen/ rdo rje 'chang byams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ byams pa rnal 'byor 'jam dpal bzang po/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse dbang po/ 'jam mgon blo gter dbang po/ 'jam dbyangs chos kyi nyi ma/ bka' drin mnyam med khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po ngag dbang gzhan phan snying po g.yon skor gyis bzhugs pa/ de thams cad kyang dpa' bo rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa can/ sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi g.yas pas bde stong gi sgra sgrogs pa'i ḍā ma ru 'khrol ba/ g.yon pas thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba thugs kar 'dzin pa/ gru mo g.yon na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bsnams pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan cing*/ gzhon nu lang tsho dar la bab pa/ skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo bor gyur/

de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas brgyud pa'i bla ma/ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs/ sangs rgyas byang sems/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro/ chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ skyabs gnas re re'ang skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo bor gyur/ thal mo sbyar la/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid// skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang*// bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku// rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud// sogs kyi bstod pa ci shes bya zhing*/ brgyud 'debs tshigs bcad lhug gang rigs kyi gsol 'debs bya/ bsdu na gang drin ma'i rjes su/ drin chen rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la gsol ba 'debs so// khyed rnams kyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes lan gsum mam brgya tshar sogs long skabs dang bstun pa'i phyag 'tshal gsol 'debs mos gus drag pos bya/ de nas/ rang gi mdun du dngos po'i longs spyod thams cad/ g.yas su gnyen byams pa thams cad/ g.yon du dgra 'dre thams cad/ rgyab dang mtha' skor kun tu bar ma'i sems can thams cad bsams la/ de thams cad rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma rnams la rim bzhin phul bas/ mnyes bzhin pas bdag gir mdzad de/ rang nyid phyin chad 'dzin chags sdang zhen rmongs pa'i las ngan thams cad dang bral bar bsam pa ni zhen pa spang ba/ yang rang gi snying ga nas mchod pa'i lha mo mchod rdzas du ma thogs pa nam mkha' gang bar spros te/ de'ang bdag gzhan thams cad kyi lus longs spyod thams cad mchod pa'i rgyur byas nas mchod pa phul bas/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma rnams kyis bdag gir mdzad de mnyes song snyam par byas nas/ phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra dhū pe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐/

oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra ne wi d+ye āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra shab+da āḥhūm̐/ zhes nyer spyod kyis mchod/ gzhan yang 'dod yon lnga/ rin chen bdun/ bkra shis rdzas rtags brgyad/ lha rdzas na bza' sogs mchod rdzas dpag tu med pas mchod/ na ma sarba= zhal shes/ lha mo rnams rang la tshur thim par bsam pa ni phyi'i mchod pa'o// yang rang gi snying ga nas lha mo thod pa thogs pa spros/ de rnams kyis rang bzhin gyi gnas nas sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga dag pa ye shes lnga'i bdud rtsi nas thod pas bcus te rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma re re nas phul bas ljags 'od zer gyi sbu gus gsol/ zag med kyi bde bas thugs mnyes par gyur par bsam zhing*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod nas lha mo rnams rang la bstim pa ni nang gi mchod pa'o// yang rang gi snying ga nas lha mo pad+ma can sogs dpag tu med pa spros/ de dag gis snyan pa'i glu len/ bde ba'i gar sgyur zhing gcig la gcig thim pa'i tshul gyis/ mthar rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gyur pa bla ma de dag gi sku la 'khril nas snyoms 'jug gi bde bas mnyes par gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma/ zhal shes/ bsam pa ni gsang ba'i mchod pa'o// de nas mchod yul/ mchod mkhan/ mchod pa'i tshul thams cad gang du'ang ma grub pa spros bral du gyur pa'i 'dzin med la blo gzhag pa ni de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa'o// de nas ku sā li'i tshogs bsag pa ni/ rang gi snying ga nas rang sems kyi ngo bo rdo rje rnal 'byor ma mtheb sor gyi tshad tsam pa zhig lus kyi dbus drang po nas rtsa dbu ma'i lam brgyud de tshangs pa'i bu ga nas rgyang ste 'thon/ des 'thur du gzigs pas rang gi lus tsho zhing snum pa/ che zhing brjid pa mkhrang nge yod pa de'i smin mtshams la phyag g.yas pa'i gri gug gis reg pa tsam gyis thod pa ling gis bkog mdun du thod pa'i sgyed pu ri rab tsam gsum grub pa'i steng du bkal ba/ de la spyan cher gzigs pas/

de nyid je che je cher song ste mthar stong gsum gyi khyon dang mnyam par gyur/ yang gri gug gis lus kyi rkang pa g.yon/ g.yas dum bu gsum du bcad nas thod pa'i steng du bskyur/ de bzhin du lus thams cad bcad nas bskyur bas sha'i ri bo/ rak+ta'i rgya mtsho/ rus pa'i gram khrod chen por gyur par bsam/ de la dmigs te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ zhes lan gsum brjod cing*/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i rkyen gyis de nyid zhu zhing khol bas bdud rtsi'i kha dog dkar po/ ro mngar ba/ reg bya bsil ba/ nus pa phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa/ dran pa tsam gyis bde chen gyi ye shes skyed nus pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur par bsams la byin gyis brlab/ rang gi snying ga nas mchod pa'i lha mo thod pa thogs pa dpag tu med pa spros/ de rnams kyis thod pas bdud rtsi nas bcus te rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma rnams la phul bas ljags 'od zer gyi sbu gus gsol bas mnyes par bsams la/ drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod nas mchod de/ lha mo de rnams rang la thim/ yang spro ba sogs gong bzhin rtsa ba'i bla ma la lan bdun phul/ de bzhin du brgyud pa'i bla ma re re nas mtshan la 'bru gsum sbyar ba'am/ mi nus na/ brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod/ gzhan yang bla ma yi dam/ sangs rgyas byang sems/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro/ chos skyong srung ma/ gnod sbyin nor lha/ dam can gter bdag rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes skyabs gnas thams cad la phul bas mnyes par bsam/ yang lha mo rnams spros te/ rigs drug bar do dang bcas pa'i sems can thams cad dang*/ rang la gnod pa'i gdon bgegs thams cad la bdud rtsi byin te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes byin pa'i bdud rtsi de mthong ba/ thos pa/ reg pa/ myong ba tsam gyis de dag thams cad tshim zhing*/ sgrib gnyis byang*/

tshogs gnyis rdzogs/ sems rtog med chos kyi sku dang*/ lus zag med rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur par bsams la/ mchod pa'i lha mo rnams tshur bsdu/ thod pa dang sgyed pu mi dmigs par bsam/ khrid dang bsnyen pa'i dus skabs 'dir maṇ+ḍal gang mang phul/ de nas rtsa ba'i bla ma la dmigs nas/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la gsol ba 'debs so// bdag la dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs par bskur du gsol/ zhes lan gsum du gsol ba btab pas/ rtsa ba'i bla mas brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams la spyan khor ro ro gzigs te/ dbang bzhi bskur ram mi bskur gyi gnang ba zhus pas/ brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyis rtsa ba'i bla ma la spyan cher gzigs nas/ de bzhin bgyi/ zhes gnang ba byin pa'i tshul gyis bla ma brgyud pa rnams g.yas skor gyis mas yar rim bzhin thim/ mthar rdo rje 'chang yang rtsa ba'i bla ma la thim par gyur par bsam/ de nas dbang bzhi blang ba ni/ bla ma'i dpral ba'i oṃ las 'od zer dkar po 'phros/ rang gi dpral bar thim pas bum pa'i dbang thob/ lus kyi sgrib pa dag lam bskyed rim bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu sprul sku thob/ sku'i byin rlabs zhugs par gyur par bsams la blo gzhag yang bla ma'i mgrin pa'i āḥlas 'od zer dmar po 'phros/ rang gi mgrin par thim pas gsang ba'i dbang thob/ ngag gi dri ma dag lam tsaṇ+ḍa li bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu longs sku thob/ gsung gi byin rlabs zhugs par gyur par bsams la blo gzhag yang bla ma'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer sngon po 'phros/ rang gi snying gar thim pas shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ yid kyi dri ma dag pho nya'i lam bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu chos sku thob/ thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs par gyur par bsams la blo gzhag yang bla ma'i gnas gsum las 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum 'phros/ rang gi lus ngag yid gsum la thim pas dbang bzhi pa thob/

sgo gsum gyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa dag lam phyag rgya chen po bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu ngo bo nyid sku thob/ sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las dang bcas pa'i byin rlabs zhugs par gyur par bsams la 'dzin med du blo gzhag yang ngag tu/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo dpal ldan bla ma dam pa la gsol ba 'debs so// bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes brjod cing*/ gsol ba btab pas/ bla ma de nyid dbu'i gtsug tor nas mar 'od du zhu/ gdan seng khri nas yar 'od du zhu ba thugs ka'i thad du 'od dmar ser li khri'i mdog can snum la 'dril ba bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin du gyur pa de nyid bde hril gyis byung nas/ rang gi spyi gtsug nas zhugs/ snying ga'i bam̐ yig dmar po de nyid la sib ste thim pas/ bam̐ yig de nyid je cher song nas 'ja' yal ba lta bur gyur par bsams la/ bla ma dang rang sems dbyer med du 'dres pa'i gshis skye med stong nyid du rjen ne ba/ gdangs 'gag med mos gus su lam me ba'i ngang du gyur pa la ji tsam gnas kyi bar du mnyam par gzhag de nas/ rang gi snying gar e e las chos 'byung gru gsum dmar po nyis brtsegs kyi steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bam̐ yig dmar po'i mthar g.yon skor du/ oṃ oṃ oṃ/ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye/ badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye/ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa'i sngags phreng gis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ lus thams cad gang*/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib thams cad dag lus 'od kyi gong bur gyur/ de yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur pa ni/ sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la zhabs g.yas brkyangs pas dus mtshan ma dmar mo'i nu ma'i steng nas mnan pa/ g.yon bskums pas 'jigs byed nag po'i mgo bo rgyab tu bltabs nas mnan pa/

sku mdog dmar mo bskal ba'i me lta bu'i gzi brjid can/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum dag pa mkha' spyod du gzigs pa/ phyag g.yas pas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug thur du brkyangs nas 'dzin pa/ g.yon pas thod pa khrag gis gang ba steng phyogs su bzung nas zhal gyen la phyogs pas gsol ba/ phrag pa g.yon par rdo rjes mtshan pa'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga la ḍā ma ru dang*/ dril bu dang*/ 'phan rtse gsum pa 'phyang bzhin pa bsnams pa/ dbu skra nag po sil bur gyur pas sku sked yan chad khebs pa/ lang tsho dar la bab cing 'dod pa'i nu 'bur rgyas pa/ bde ba skyed pa'i nyams can/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ gcer bu phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ rnam snang gi cod pan can/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// de'i snying gar e e las chos 'byung gru gsum dmar po nyis brtsegs kyi steng du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bam̐ yig dmar po'i mthar g.yon skor du sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba/ de las 'od zer 'phros te ba spu'i bu ga nas phyir song*/ rigs drug gi sems can thams cad la phog pas sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa sbyangs/ de thams cad rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dpral ba'i dbyings su g.yon du lan gsum bskor zhing*/ phaiṃ/ rang gi snying ga'i bam̐ yig las 'od zer 'phros pas 'og min nas rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyogs bcu'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyis bskor ba dang*/ 'gro ba rnal 'byor mar gyur pa thams cad kyang bdag nyid la thim par gyur/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes pa phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ gnyis su med par thim/ ye shes pa bcug pa'i bde ba chen po'i rkyen gyis rang gi snying ga'i bam̐ yig 'od du zhu ba las/ dbus su srog gi ngo bo bam̐ yig dang*/ 'byung bzhi'i yi ge ya ra la wa'i yi ger gyur pa/

mtha' skor du sngags phreng yig 'bru sum cu rtsa gnyis dang ldan pa/ de rnams lhar gsal ba ni/ dbus su rnal 'byor ma dmar mo/ mdun du dkar mo/ g.yon du ljang gu/ rgyab tu dmar mo/ g.yas su ser mo/ mtha' skor gyi rnal 'byor ma rnams dmar mo/ de thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum dag pa mkha' spyod du gzigs pa/ phyag g.yas pas rdo rje mtshan pa'i gri gug thur du brkyangs nas 'dzin pa/ g.yon pas thod pa khrag gis gang ba steng phyogs su bzung nas zhal gyen la phyogs pas gsol ba/ phrag pa g.yon pa la rdo rjes mtshan pa'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga la ḍā ma ru dang*/ dril bu dang*/ 'phan rtse gsum pa 'phyang bzhin pa bsnams pa/ dbu skra nag po sil bur gyur pas sku sked yan chad khebs pa/ lang tsho dar la bab cing 'dod pa'i nu 'bur rgyas pa/ bde ba skyed pa'i nyams can/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ gcer bu phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyangs shing g.yon bskums pas 'jigs byed dang dus mtshan ma mnan pa/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par gyur/ ces brjod cing gsal 'debs pa'am/ bsams pas kyang rung ste/ lus dkyil gsal gdab/ pad skor gyi mthar 'khyud rgya byas la/ oṃ yo ga shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥyo ga shud+dho ྅haṃ/ thabs shes gnyis su med pa'i bde chen gyi ye shes su bdag nyid rnam par dag la/ de bzhin du chos thams cad kyang dag go snyam pa'i nga rgyal gzung zhing rig pa 'dzin med du gzhag de nas go cha bcing ba ni/ rang nyid rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i phyi'i gnas rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ lte bar oṃ bam̐ dmar mo rdo rje phag mo/ snying gar ham̐ yoṃ sngon mo gshin rje ma/ khar hriṃ moṃ dkar mo rmongs byed ma/ dpral bar hriṃ hriṃ ser mo skyod byed ma/ spyi gtsug tu hūm̐ hūm̐ ljang gu skrag byed ma/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭa phaṭa dud ka tsaṇ+ḍi kā'i ngo bor gyur/

ces brjod cing bsam/ de nas ngag bzlas ni/ lus dkyil gyi gtso mo'i thugs kar chos 'byung gru gsum dmar po nyis brtsegs kyi nang du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bam̐ yig gi mthar sngags phreng kha dog dmar pos g.yon du bskor ba/ de las 'od zer dmar po dpag tu med pa 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ sangs rgyas thams cad mchod/ de rnams kyi byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad 'od zer dmar po'i rnam par spyan drangs/ sngags phreng la thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs par gyur/ ces brjod cing*/ de lta bu'i dmigs pa dang ma bral par/ oṃ ru tsi ra ma ṇa pra brta ya hūm̐/ nor bu rgyas pa'i gzhal med khang gi gzungs las gsungs pa'i phreng sngags so// mchan/ oṃ oṃ oṃ/ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye/ badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye/ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ brgya rtsa la sogs pa ci tsam dam bcas pa bzla/ yid bzlas ni/ snying ga'i chos 'byung zla ba yig 'bru dang bcas pa/ bde ba skyed par 'dod na gsang gnas dang*/ mi rtog pa skyed par 'dod na lte bar phab ste/ sngags phreng lan gsum mam bdun la sogs par bklag pa'i tshul du sems gtad nas rlung kha sbyor ci thub 'dzin/ yang chos 'byung gi mdun rgyab spangs pa'i grwa bzhir dga' ba 'khyil pa g.yon skor du 'khor ba la sems gtad pas bde ba'i ye shes bskyed par bsams la rlung kha sbyor gzung*/ yang smin mtshams dang gsang gnas su dga' 'khyil g.yon skor du shugs drag tu 'khor ba la sems gtad de rlung kha sbyor gzung*/ dga' 'khyil gnyis mthar snying ga'i bam̐ yig la thim par bsams te zhar byung gi rdzogs rim gnyis bsgom// ༈ //rdzogs rim dngos kyi rtsa dbu ma kha dbye ba dang*/ dbye nas bsgoms pa la/ rlung lus la gnas pas bde ba sgrub pa dang*/ sems la gnas pas 'ja' lus sgrub pa rnams man ngag ltar bsgom/

de'i mthar nang gi mkha' spyod sgrub pa'i bsam mi khyab thun mong ma yin pa rnams kyi dmigs pa ji ltar rigs pa'i mthar/ 'dzin med kyi ngang du ci gnas gzhag de'i ngang las rang nyid thun mtshams kyi rje btsun ma rgyan dang phyag mtshan med pa'i skur ldang zhing go cha bgo ba ni/ rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i gnas rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ lte bar oṃ bam̐ dmar mo rdo rje phag mo/ zhes pa nas/ phaṭa phaṭa dud ka tsaṇ+ḍi kā'i ngo bos mtshan par gyur/ ces brjod/ bsrung ba ni/ lag pa g.yon pa'i sdigs mdzub kyis se gol phyogs g.yon skor dang mtshams g.yas skor gyis brdab cing sngags brjod pa ni/ shar dang steng du/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ khwa gdong ma sngon mo shar dang*/ khaṇ+ḍa ro hi dmar mo steng*/ byang du/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ 'ug gdong ma ljang mo byang*/ nub dang 'og tu/ oṃ gṛh+ṇā pa ya gṛh+ṇā pa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ khyi gdong ma dmar mo nub dang*/ khaṇ+ḍa ro hi dmar mo 'og lhor/ oṃ ā na ya hoḥbha ga wān bid+yā rā dza hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ phag gdong ma ser mo lhor/ ༈ shar lhor/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ shar lhor gshin rje ma sngo ser/ lho nub tu/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ lho nub tu gshin rje pho nya ma ser dmar/ nub byang du/ oṃ gṛh+ṇā pa ya gṛh+ṇā pa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ nub byang du gshin rje mche ba ma dmar ljang*/ byang shar du/ oṃ ā na ya hoḥbha ga wān bid+yā rā dza hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ byang shar du gshin rje 'joms ma ljang sngon te/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad ka zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ dang po gnyis ḍā ma ru dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'og ma gnyis gri thod thogs pa grangs med pa spros pas bgegs rnams tshar gcod cing srung ba'i gur du bzhugs par bsam/ mchan/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag

sogs bsngo ba dang*/ mkha' spyod zhal bzang blta ba'i smon lam/ phun tshogs dge legs sogs kyi bkra shis bya'o// thun mthar gtor ma dbul na/ bsam mi khyab kyi nyams len grub rjes/ rang thun mtshams kyi lhar gsal bas/ mngon rtogs na bzhugs pa ltar gyi gtor bsngo dang*/ de'i rjes chos skyong srung ma/ dur bdag mkha' 'gro spyi gtor/ gzhi bdag sogs thams cad la 'bul tshul phyag len ltar byas rjes/ rang nyid la go cha dang bsrung ba/ bsngo ba smon lam/ bkra shis sogs gong bzhin mdzad do// 'di ni thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyun gyi nyams len rgyas pa'i go rim ma 'khrul bar gsung rgyun ltar phyogs gcig tu bkod pa ste/ rang gi nyams len dang*/ nyams khrid tshul bzhin skyong ba'i rdo rje'i slob bu rnams la phan pa'i bsam pa dang*/ khyad par nor 'dzin dbang mo kun dga' chos 'dzin sgrol ma'i thugs dam nyams bzhes su/ khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po rmor chen chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs rdul spyi bos mchod cing*/ gsung gi bdud rtsi myong ba'i bka' 'bangs kyi rig pa 'dzin pa ngag dbang kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas kyis zin bris su bgyis pa'o// 'dis kyang rje btsun gong ma'i thugs dam gyi snying po gsang chen slob bshad zab mo'i bstan pa dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig/ //maṅga laṃ// 'di ltar nyams len ma nus na/ tshar chen rdo rje 'chang chen pos mdzad pa'i mngon rtogs ltar nyams su blangs na chag med kyi don tshang zhing*/ dpe 'di khrid legs par thob pa rnams la bstan gyi/ byin rlabs tsam thob pa/ shes shing mkhas par rlom pa rnams la mi ston cing gsang bar mdzad du gsol// //sarba maṅga laṃ// ༈ /na mo badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa lī ye/ mkha' spyod zhal bzang lta ba'i smon lam bzhugs so// ༄/ na mo badz+ra wā ra hi ye/ mtha' yas rgyal ba'i bde stong zlos gar ni// srid zhi'i mig 'phrul cir yang snang ba las// deng 'dir mkha' spyod dpal mo yid 'ong ma// snying nas dran no 'khyud pa'i rtse dgas skyongs// 'og min gnas na lhan skyes rgyal yum ma// nyer bzhi'i yul na zhing skyes ḍā ki ma// nor 'dzin khyab par karma mu dra ma// rnal 'byor bdag gi skyabs mgon rje btsun ma// khyod ni sems nyid stong pa'i rang rtsal te// rdo rje'i grong na e dbyings bam̐ gyi dngos// sgyu ma'i gling na 'jigs rung srin mo dang*// 'dzum dkar g.yo ba'i lang tsho gsal bar ston// de ni bdag gis ji ltar btsal gyur kyang*// bden par grub pa'i nges pa ma rnyed nas// spros pas dub pa'i sems kyi skyes bu de// brjod bral nags kyi khang bur ngal gso bsten// e ma da ni ḍā ki'i dbyings nas bzhengs// he ru ka dpal rgyud kyi rgyal po las// rdo rje btsun mo'i nye ba'i snying po mchog

/bklags pas 'grub ces gsung ba'i bden pas skyongs// o ḍī ya ni bas mtha'i nags khrod du// grub pa'i dbang phyug rdo rje dril bu pa// 'khyud dang tsum+pa'i bde bas rjes bskyongs nas// mkha' spyod gnas su khrid bzhin bdag kyang skyongs// gaṅgā'i gling du rje btsun ku sā li// mngon sum nam mkha'i dbyings su khrid pa dang*// dpal ldan nā ro tā pa rje bzung ltar// bdag kyang mkha' spyod dga' ma'i grong du khrid// rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams kyi thugs rje dang*// rgyud chen gsang mtha'i zab lam myur ched dang*// rnal 'byor bdag gi lhag bsam dag pa'i mthus// mkha' spyod dga' ma'i 'dzum zhal myur mthong shog /ces pa'ang thol byung du smras so// zhes tshar chen rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa'o// lha mo tshad ma dam tshig tshad ma dang*// des gsungs tshig kyang tshad ma'i mchog yin pas// bden pa de dag gis ni bdag cag rnams// rtag tu rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig /'chi tshe mgon dang dpa' bo ma tshogs kyis// me tog gdugs dang rgyal mtshan thogs nas su// rol mo glu dbyangs sgra snyan sogs mchod cing*// mkha' la spyod pa'i gnas su 'khrid par shog /ces smon lam btab/ de nas bkra shis ni/ phun tshogs dge legs kun gyi dpal mnga' ba// rdo rje 'chang chen paṇa chen nā ro sogs// dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i tshogs rnams kyi// byin rlabs myur du 'jug pa'i bkra shis shog /rgyal ba'i yum mchog shes rab pha rol phyin// rang bzhin 'od gsal gdod nas spros dang bral// brtan g.yo'i dngos kun spro dang sdud mdzad ma// mkha' spyod chos kyi sku yi bkra shis shog /mtshan dpe'i dpal 'bar rab mdzes brjid pa'i sku// drug cu'i dbyangs ldan theg mchog sgrogs pa'i gsung*// ye shes lnga ldan bde gsal mi rtog thugs// lhan skyes longs spyod rdzogs pa'i bkra shis shog /sna tshogs zhing du sna tshogs gzugs sku yi// sna tshogs thabs kyis sna tshogs gdul bya'i don// sna tshogs bsam pa ji bzhin sgrub mdzad pa// zhing skyes sprul pa'i sku yi bkra shis shog

/pad+ma rā ga'i mdog mtshungs rje btsun ma// 'dzum khro'i nyams ldan zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis// gri thod legs 'dzin zhabs zung brkyang bskum tshul// thugs skyes mkha' spyod mchog gi bkra shis shog /gang gi rnam 'phrul grangs med bye ba phrag /stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis tshogs rnams kyis// sgrub pa po yi bar chad kun sel zhing*// 'dod don dngos grub stsol ba'i bkra shis shog/ //ces chos rje byams pa chos legs pas mdzad pa'i bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa 'dis mtshon bkra shis rgyas par brjod do// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
